title: Took me a while to figure out how to do it so it would hang
text: Took me a while to figure out how to do it so it would hang. This was my first time using one of this & it was a little hard for me to figure out. If you are doing a straight garland, I would put the strip up first and put a balloon in every couple of holes & then go back & fill in as needed. If you are doing big clusters, you could put balloons in first, or hang strip first, but I would still do every other hole because it makes it too full to manage with every hole filled before hanging.

product_metadata.title: Reusable Balloon Arch Decorating Strip for Party Decorations, 32 Feet - 1 Pack
features: What’s included: 1x 32 feet balloon decorating strip, made from sturdy plastic, max. hold 110 balloons

Easy to use: Thanks for the time-saving double-hole design, we can quickly make a balloon garland in 30 minutes. Just need to insert inflated balloon knot into large hole first then slide to smaller hole to hold in place

Perfect for party decoration: This balloon strip can be used to connected various sizes of latex balloons, foil balloons, easy to make any beautiful balloon arch shapes you want, bring you a variety of beautiful graphic styles as a shock for wedding, birthday, baby shower, etc
